NAME
    set - Set inputs referenced by channels for a role to a specific revision

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] inputs channel set [command options] <channels> <role> <rev>

COMMAND OPTIONS
    --[no-]allow_shared  - Allow setting inputs shared with other channels/roles
    --[no-]changelog     - (default: enabled)
    --[no-]commit        - 
    -d, --[no-]downgrade - 
    --[no-]editor        - (default: enabled)
